verse.verse_2: And what is that indubitable event?
verse.verse_3: And what do you know what that indubitable event is?
verse.verse_4: The Thamud and the Ad denied the (possibility of a) sudden calamity, calling it false.
verse.verse_5: Then the Thamud were destroyed by an awesome upheaval;
verse.verse_6: and the Ad were destroyed by a furiously raging wind-storm
verse.verse_7: which He let loose upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession; so that (if you had been there) you might have seen people lying prostrate, as though they were uprooted trunks of hollowed palm trees.
verse.verse_8: Do you now see any trace of them?
verse.verse_9: Pharaoh and those before him and the people of the overturned habitations all engaged in the same great sin.
verse.verse_10: They did not follow the Messenger of their Lord, and so He seized them with a severe grip.
verse.verse_11: Verily when the water rose to great heights, We bore you upon a floating vessel (i.e. the Ark)
verse.verse_12: so that We might make it an instructive event for you, and retentive ears might preserve its memory.
verse.verse_13: So when the Trumpet is blown with a single blast
verse.verse_14: and the earth and the mountains are carried aloft and are crushed to bits at one stroke,
verse.verse_15: on that Day shall that indubitable event come to pass;
verse.verse_16: when the sky will be rent asunder, the grip holding it together having loosened on that Day,
verse.verse_17: and the angels will stand on the sides, with eight of them bearing aloft the Throne of your Lord on that Day.
verse.verse_18: That will be the Day when you shall be brought forth (before Allah) and no secret of yours shall remain hidden.
verse.verse_19: On that Day, he whose Record is given to him in his right hand will say: “Lo! Read my Record!
verse.verse_20: Verily I was sure that I would be handed over my account.”
verse.verse_21: Then he shall find himself in a life of bliss;
verse.verse_23: the clusters of whose fruit will be hanging low to be within reach (of the inmates of Paradise).
verse.verse_24: (They will be told): “Eat and drink with good cheer as a reward for the good deeds you did in the days that have passed by.”
verse.verse_25: As for him whose Record will be given to him in his left hand, he will exclaim: “Would that I had never been given my Record,
verse.verse_26: and had not known my account.
verse.verse_27: Oh! Would that the death that came to me in the world had made an end of me!
verse.verse_28: My riches have not availed me,
verse.verse_30: (A command will be issued): “Seize him and shackle him,
verse.verse_31: then cast him in the Fire,
verse.verse_32: then fasten him with a chain, seventy cubits long.
verse.verse_33: He would not believe in Allah, the Most Great;
verse.verse_34: nor would he urge the feeding of the poor.
verse.verse_35: Today he has been left here friendless;
verse.verse_36: and has no food except the filth from the washing of wounds,
verse.verse_37: which only the sinners will eat.”
verse.verse_38: But no; I swear by what you see,
verse.verse_39: and by what you do not see,
verse.verse_40: that this is the speech of an honourable Messenger,
verse.verse_41: not the speech of a poet. Little do you believe!
verse.verse_42: Nor is this the speech of a soothsayer. Little do you reflect!
verse.verse_43: It has been revealed by the Lord of the Universe.
verse.verse_44: And if he [i.e., the Prophets] had forged this Discourse and thereafter ascribed it to Us,
verse.verse_45: We would surely have seized him by the right hand,
verse.verse_46: and then severed his life vein;
verse.verse_47: and not one of you would have been able to withhold Us from doing so.
verse.verse_48: Surely it is a Good Counsel for the God-fearing.
verse.verse_49: We certainly know that some among you will give the lie to it,
verse.verse_50: and surely it will be a cause of regret for the unbelievers.
verse.verse_51: Certainly it is a Truth of absolute certainty.
verse.verse_52: So glorify the name of your Lord Most Great.
